verdict.rationale: The project's own docs state that its helper scripts are six standard-library Python files and that none touch the network. That is a thin first-party statement about what executes and implies no outbound data flow. There is no dedicated security section, no trust model for third-party skills, and no explicit telemetry or data-collection policy. Missing for 10: an explicit documented scope of what each skill can execute or modify, a trust model or guidance for third-party skills, an explicit telemetry and data-collection statement, and independent corroboration.
